delete.description: Clears every HybridCache entry held by the Core API process. Caches outside HybridCache, such as the OpenID Connect metadata and signing keys held by the authentication middleware, are NOT affected. Neither is the Gateway, which runs as a separate process with its own cache - its JWKS, internal token, Vault access key and user permission caches survive this call.
